## Purpose
`renderErrorPage()`: the standalone HTML page returned when SSR fails catastrophically.

## Responsibilities
It returns a full HTML document titled "This page didn't load", containing:
- the text "Something went wrong on our end. You can try refreshing or head back home.";
- a "Try again" button (`location.reload()`) and a "Go home" link (`/`);
- inline styles only.

## Key elements
`renderErrorPage`.
